areaNote: The main Ithaca campus polygon (way/108626313), the largest member of OSM's Cornell University relation/11625564; the relation's other members are farms and field stations 15-20 km east.
noCodes: No downloadable code list: the Registrar shows one building's abbreviation per page (registrar.cornell.edu/academicbuildings/<code>, e.g. BKL) with no index or list page in its site map, and Facilities' inventory codes (fcs.cornell.edu/inventory) are internal facility numbers, not the class-roster abbreviations (checked 2026-11-08).
